item.text: I’ll refactor only the target test class, first checking its existing lifecycle and mock setup so the helper preserves each test’s exact behavior.

The repeated setup is local to five tests, so I’m extracting a small helper that returns a fresh `RegistryFactory` mock and stubs it against that test’s URL and registry. Each test will still receive its own mock.

I found three tests that pass the mock into an extension-loader stub before the registry URL is ready. I’m preserving the final stubbing point and moving only that loader wiring after the helper returns the mock; the loader is not invoked until the test action.

The source formatting check passed. Maven reached the target test, but the JDK hit an `AccessDeniedException` while closing jars in the local Maven cache during compilation; I’m checking the Surefire report to distinguish that environment issue from the test result.
